text:
lucas ford: Quick micro-play idea: 'probe-launch-labs'  test a short launch post + tiny webinar + 2-step credit seeding. Goal: increase 3-day prompt runs. Keep it small. Thoughts?
amira saleh: Like it. Recommend 700 impressions, seed 150 users with 20 credits each. Split social creative and 2 email subjects. Who owns routing?
lucas ford: @paco can you own routing + cohort tagging? @sophie can take copy. I'll run webinar ops.
paco rios: Yep. Routing rule (pseudocode):
```
if (request.query.utm_campaign == 'probe_launch_labs') {
  user.meta.cohort = 'probe_labs_v1';
  emit('probe.credit_seeded');
}
```
I'll expose cohort_id probe_labs_v1.
sophie ma: Copy brief: straightforward + action-oriented. Headline: "20 free credits + starter prompts". Email A: "Try Redwood: 20 free credits" Email B: "Build an AI demo tonight  20 credits inside" Social captions short with ?utm_campaign=probe_launch_labs links.
amira saleh: UX ask: success page should surface one preselected starter prompt and a "Run this prompt" CTA. Also a tiny calendar link for a 20-min webinar. I can ship a variant to staging.
lucas ford: Measurement: funnel = impression -> signup -> first prompt-run (24h). Track prompt_run rate, time-to-first-run, and avg tokens per new user. Decision gate: if prompt-run uplift > 14% scale to 5k impressions.
paco rios: Tech notes: initial credit grant via feature flag `probe_seed_v1`. I'll open a small PR and make sure analytics captures events `probe.credit_seeded` and `probe.prompt_run`.
growth-bot: Reminder: campaign jobs need 36 hours lead time. Schedule check required.
sophie ma: I'll draft two social posts and 3 starter prompts (summarizer, code helper, brainstorming) and post in #marketing-drafts by EOD.
amira saleh: Timeline: prep Tue, soft launch Wed 9am PT to 700 impressions, measure 72h, webinar Thu 11am PT (15-min demo + Q).
lucas ford: Decision: proceed. Seed 150 users @20 credits. @paco add cohort + flag, @sophie drop drafts, @amira stage landing. growth-bot  schedule check 36h before launch. :rocket:
